# Mazen EL-Gayar

> Mazen EL-Gayar is a software engineer and independent game developer based in Port Said, Egypt. He builds cross-platform products with Flutter and Dart, backend APIs with NestJS and Node.js, and games with Unreal Engine 5. He has 4+ years of software development experience, works part-time as a Senior Software Engineer at DoctorVoice, and founded MazenX, an independent game studio.

## Professional focus

- Flutter and Dart for Android, iOS, web, and Windows applications
- NestJS, Node.js, and REST APIs
- Clean Architecture, OOP, design patterns, dependency injection, CI/CD, code review, Agile/Scrum
- Unreal Engine 5, Blueprints, C++, gameplay systems, movement, combat, and enemy AI
- Technical coordination across QC, AI, backend, frontend, mobile, and data-analysis teams; mentored 5+ DoctorVoice interns and 7 RASID graduates (12+ people total)

## Experience

- DoctorVoice — Senior Software Engineer, part-time (May 2024–present)
- MazenX — Founder and Independent Game Developer (July 2026–present)
- FlexoNexus — Senior Flutter Developer, full-time (January–March 2026)
- Grwan LLC — Flutter Developer / Project Manager, full-time (March–December 2025)
- RASID — Flutter Developer Lead & Mentor, full-time (April 2024–March 2025)

## Selected projects

- LeanGo — Flutter operations family at GLI, a GRWAN Group company. Eye supports security and field operations; FTE supports attendance and employee workflows; FM supports facilities and asset services; CIL reports on machine quality, equipment effectiveness, and operator tasks through a mobile app and dashboard. The modular, role-permission-based suite also includes GPS, face, or QR attendance; QR asset lookup; post task tracking; localization; notifications; and client-specific white-label features. Also includes E&T and related tools. [Google Play apps](https://play.google.com/store/apps/developer?id=GRWAN+GROUP+FZE) · [Apple App Store apps](https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/grwan-group-fze/id1619845290)
- Multi-tenant ERP platform — FlexoNexus app centralizes payments, expenses, BNPL, invoices, accounts receivable, attendance, and occupancy monitoring. Delivered four Flutter app flavors: Food & Health, NDS, Restaurants, and FlexoNexus.
- DoctorVoice — patient and doctor healthcare products with Flutter and NestJS, speech-to-text medical documentation, specialty selection, and initial report generation. Mazen coordinates QC, AI, backend, frontend, mobile, and data-analysis teams, mentors 5+ interns, and liaises between the CEO, Marketing, and technical teams.
- Open-source Flutter packages published under MazenX: [PayPal checkout](https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_paypal_payment_checkout_v2) · [i18n translator](https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_i18n_translator) · [MazenX pub.dev profile](https://pub.dev/publishers/mazenx.dev/packages)
- Crazy Kix — independently built Unreal Engine action platformer featuring platform movement, cannons, chasing drones, and laser attacks. [GitHub source](https://github.com/MazenxELGayar/Jetpack) · [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9nst3zj3r8d7) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mazenx.crazykix)
- The Bone Runner — independently built 2D action platformer featuring combat, skeleton enemies, spikes, saws, and dungeon stages. [Source](https://github.com/MazenxELGayar/TheBoneRunner) · [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9phqzbvkflf5?hl=en-US&gl=EG) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mazenx.thebonerunner)
- Gambling Addiction — Unreal Engine Blueprint arena game with randomized magic-ball effects and Bot vs Bots, Human vs Bot, and Bots vs Humans modes. [Repository](https://github.com/MazenxELGayar/gambling-addiction)
- MyFlix and MyFlix Remote — connected Windows and Android media apps with local library organization, metadata enrichment, resume playback, and synchronized remote control. [Windows app](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9p61pw36ppqw) · [Android remote](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mazenx.myflix_remote)
- Samsarly — real-estate marketplace with map discovery, filters, AI-assisted estimates, token-based contact and navigation, and Arabic, English, French, Spanish, German, and Turkish localization.
